source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "affordable housing" OR "housing policy" OR "public housing" OR "social housing"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"affordable housing" OR "housing policy" OR "public housing" OR "social housing",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("affordable housing" OR "housing policy" OR "public housing" OR "social housing")
